fields.title: Prefix of output columns
fields.description: New column names start with this prefix followed by a numeric index.

fields.title: Vector column
fields.description: The column containing the vectors to expand into individual columns.

fields.title: Remove original column
fields.description: If checked, the selected vector column will be removed from the output table.

fields.title: Use the column names specified in properties
fields.description:
If checked and the vector column contains element name metadata those names are used as output column names
instead of the generated prefix-based names.

fields.title: Start index for the first new column
fields.description: The numeric part of the generated column names will start from this index.

fields.title: Maximum number of new columns
fields.description:
The maximum number of output columns to generate. Vector values at positions beyond this limit will be
omitted from the output table.
